variants.exit_confirm: Require the existing three-black condition on two consecutive completed closes (four descending bearish candles after entry). Original loss12 and time63 retain priority and are never delayed.
variants.poc_strength: Rank reservable candidates by (poc_after/poc_before-1) descending, original priority then event_id for ties, retaining each original POC hard/priority gate. Quality unknown retains the original explicit policy; no invented strength.
variants.correlation60: Keep original ranking; refuse a new candidate if its 60 completed signal-date daily returns have Pearson correlation >0.80 with an existing held stock or an already reserved new candidate. Require 60 common finite returns and nonzero variance; missing evidence blocks admission explicitly.

controls: Immutable original accounts and same-cost 0050 from poc_optimization_20261013; no cooldown and no combined optimization variants.
execution_evidence: Audit original planned orders against available dated ordinary prints. Do not infer chronological intraday odd fills from daily aggregates. Frozen-order diagnostics are not a rerun account, and do not produce executable net return. Causal ordinary trade-through estimates use existing 09:01-13:25 model and preplanned legal limits; own queue is unverified.
research_execution: For isolated exit/ranking/allocation sensitivity only retain original T+1 HL2 buy and sell L+0.3*(H-L). These results cannot qualify executable trading.
decision: All four cases must beat their own original net return with no worse drawdown to retain an optimization. Historical qualification also requires positive net return, positive same-cost 0050 excess, and no worse drawdown than 0050 in all four cases.
paper_gate: Require complete stress matrix, historical qualification, independently causal whole-account execution verification, point-in-time/adjustment/corporate coverage, genuinely unseen version-locked 126 sessions and 30 settled cohorts with positive net/excess and no worse benchmark drawdown. Frozen-order estimates alone cannot pass.
trials: Record successful and failed attempts. No parameter search after outcomes.
